There is no documentation at the time of sampling where within the room the samples have been taken so that any alert or action levels documented can be adequately assessed. b. There is no data to support that the (b) filling equipment locations selected for post-fill monitoring of surface microbial contamination (RODAC) propriate in assessing the filling equipment surfaces. There is no monitoring of filling needles that directly contact Ck and enter vials or of the needle manifold surface that slides directly over open vials during filling. c.
